LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiRitualPattern.shortDescOverrid: A festival rite beside the lotus pond, praying for artistry and flowing music.
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiRitualPattern.ritualExplanatio: The Qixi rite must be hosted by Qinghe beside the lotus pond. Ritual quality affects participants' mood memory, and a completed rite yields lost Qinghe score fragments. Good outcomes may inspire handiwork or artistry.
